consensus_findings.description: Review starting: gathering OpenSpec package scope, schemas, and the exact commit range before scoring wp-digest-module.
Key/path safety: Implementation correctly encodes stub keys for safe filename construction and validates all paths to prevent directory traversal attacks.
Capacity atomicity: Implementation properly handles candidate capacity bounds with atomic operations that fail gracefully when exceeding the 20-candidate limit.
Lifecycle/dry-run behavior: Implementation correctly implements dry-run mode that reports results without persisting changes and handles lifecycle maintenance operations appropriately.
Score/time/key validation: Implementation strictly validates score documents against manifests, ensuring exact key coverage and timestamp matching before any cache or digest writes.
Dependency status semantics: Implementation builds a strict dependency status index that correctly distinguishes completed, blocked, pending, and archived dependencies.
Git staleness computation: Implementation correctly computes staleness days using Git commit timestamps and properly handles clock skew scenarios with appropriate degradation markers.
Deterministic cache/rank: Implementation ensures deterministic ranking through strict formula-based scoring and consistent tie-breaking using stub_key ordering.
Journal crash recovery: Implementation includes robust transactional journaling with fsync operations and proper recovery mechanisms that ensure atomicity of digest updates.
Evidence containment/sanitization: Implementation properly sanitizes and bounds evidence content, treating all provenance as untrusted data with appropriate delimiters and redaction.
Stub-to-request no writes: Implementation correctly avoids writing to roadmap files directly, instead generating pure refiner requests that maintain separation of concerns.
Decision merge: Implementation properly handles decision merging into supervisor records with appropriate validation of conditional metadata fields.
AST host-assisted invariant: Implementation correctly avoids direct model/network calls and maintains host-assisted architecture through static analysis verification.

All eight-axis risks addressed: Implementation properly addresses correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance, observability, resilience, and compatibility concerns across all reviewed aspects.
